input: In which part of the municipality of Amersfoort is the most construction currently taking place? Answer with only a JSON object with the key "part": the name of the area.

metadata.hypothesis: 'Currently under construction' is a status of a pand, Bouw gestart, and 'part' is a wijk of the CBS Wijk- en Buurtkaart. The agent has to find that status, count per area and name the area with most. Likely failures: counting building permits (Bouwvergunning verleend) instead of construction that has started, counting verblijfsobjecten instead of panden, which makes De Hoef lead, or news and planning documents from the web instead of the BAG.
metadata.location: BAG panden of gemeente Amersfoort with status Bouw gestart, grouped by wijknaam
